verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a side-by-side layout and keeps the headline, body, CTA and legal text readable, but the logo shrinks to a tiny dot in a large empty dark block, the orange divider is left floating, the body copy runs full-width at near-headline weight, and the small CTA is crammed into the bottom-left with no breathing room. B is just the original shrunk: the headline survives, but the body copy, the 'Reserve a Case' button label, 'Ships late June' and the legal line are too small to read, the logo is tiny, and there is dead space at the top and bottom, so it fails readability badly.
